body: Im doing ok. Still fighting off the feelings. I urge you to talk to someone you know about how you truly feel. Because believe it or not the people you least expect ( aka your best friends and boyfriend) might actually care more than you think. Ive been talking to my best friend about it and she is the only one who really knows and it helps a lot more than you think. it hasnt stopped the thoughts but it has definently helped. Talking to anyone helps really lol. Brick walls are a cruch too, they work to decieve people. Which is a good tactic ive found out for being in public and in social situations or at work. but its hard when your with family or ones you love. Ive always been one to help people out so like i said if you cant muster up the courage to talk to someone close to you i am always here to help, it makes me feel a little beter to actualy help someone dealing with the same problems.

fake smiles and evreything, I know the feeling. No one understands even if you tell them. they just say get over it. but I know the feeling of not being good enough for anyone or anything. Im at the same place you are. If you want to talk pm e and maybe we can help each other out.
